meta.title: The Survival of Sarah Rose — AI Voice Pack + 11 Languages
meta.description: Unofficial fan patch: demo AI voice acting in 11 languages plus translations into 11 (Russian complete; the others cover the intro up to the first choice). Free, 18+.

features.title: What you get
features.translateText: Russian — the whole story. Other languages — the opening (demo scope).
features.voiceText: Cloned voices, one per character, with the emotion matched to each scene.
features.voicesText: Sarah, Kate, King Orwell, Thomas, Varga and dozens more.

demo.title: Hear it in action
demo.lead: Real in-game lines with AI voice acting: cloned voices, live emotions. Hit a line — and hear the result.

phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: But seriously, Thomas, you should listen to Dad at least some of the time. He's only trying to do what is best for us.

phrases.speaker: Kate
phrases.text: It's a little late to start pretending to be modest now, Sarah.

phrases.speaker: King Orwell Rose
phrases.text: Anyone can be a king in the easy times. It's the bad times that a king needs to be ready for. And your brother isn't ready.

voice.title: Voice acting — demo ready
voice.ru: Russian (RU): complete translation, demo scope voiced
voice.en: English (EN): the original text, demo scope voiced
voice.missing: If a line has no voice file yet — the game just plays it silently (no errors, no crashes).

install.title: Installation
install.step1: Download the pack on Nexus Mods — start with main (required), then add the voice packs you want.
install.step2: Unpack main.7z into the game folder (where TheSurvivalofSarahRose.exe is): you get mods/tssr-ai-voice-pack and environment.txt. Voice packs — the same way.
install.step3: Start the game, open the mod menu (badge in the top-right) and pick your language.
install.note: Requires the game bought on Steam. Unofficial fan patch, not affiliated with the developers.
install.vortexHint: Using Vortex? Install the game extension once, then use “Install from file”.
